ucs.title: [LLM] Kimsuky (APT43 / Emerald Sleet / Velvet Chollima) SHARPEXT browser-extension implant via Chromium Secure Preferences hijack
ucs.description: Hunts the signature SHARPEXT installation pattern: a non-browser process (PowerShell, mshta, wscript, cscript) writing to Chrome / Edge / Naver Whale 'Secure Preferences' / 'Preferences' / manifest.json / bg.js files. SHARPEXT is the Volexity-documented Kimsuky / SharpTongue browser-extension that quietly siphons Gmail / AOL / Naver mail from authenticated sessions of think-tank, journalist, NK-defector and ROK government targets — a TTP fingerprint that is essentially unique to this actor cluster.
ucs.splunk: | tstats summariesonly=true count min(_time) as firstTime max(_time) as lastTime from datamodel=Endpoint.Filesystem where (Filesystem.file_path IN ("*\\Google\\Chrome\\User Data\\*","*\\Microsoft\\Edge\\User Data\\*","*\\Naver\\Naver Whale\\User Data\\*") AND Filesystem.file_name IN ("Secure Preferences","Preferences","manifest.json","bg.js") AND Filesystem.process_name IN ("powershell.exe","pwsh.exe","wscript.exe","cscript.exe","mshta.exe","cmd.exe","rundll32.exe")) by Filesystem.dest Filesystem.user Filesystem.process_name Filesystem.process_path Filesystem.file_path Filesystem.file_name | `drop_dm_object_name(Filesystem)` | convert ctime(firstTime) ctime(lastTime) | sort - lastTime
ucs.kql:
// Kimsuky / SHARPEXT — script-host writes to Chromium-family Preferences
DeviceFileEvents
| where Timestamp > ago(7d)
| where FolderPath has_any (@"\Google\Chrome\User Data\", @"\Microsoft\Edge\User Data\", @"\Naver\Naver Whale\User Data\")
| where FileName in~ ("Secure Preferences", "Preferences", "manifest.json", "bg.js")
| where InitiatingProcessFileName !in~ ("chrome.exe", "msedge.exe", "whale.exe", "msedgewebview2.exe", "GoogleUpdate.exe", "MicrosoftEdgeUpdate.exe")
| where InitiatingProcessFileName in~ ("powershell.exe", "pwsh.exe", "wscript.exe", "cscript.exe", "mshta.exe", "cmd.exe", "rundll32.exe", "regsvr32.exe")
| where InitiatingProcessAccountName !endswith "$"
| project Timestamp, DeviceName, InitiatingProcessAccountName,
          InitiatingProcessFileName, InitiatingProcessCommandLine,
          InitiatingProcessParentFileName,
          FileName, FolderPath, ActionType, SHA256
| order by Timestamp desc
ucs.sentinel_kql:
// Kimsuky / SHARPEXT — script-host writes to Chromium-family Preferences
ImFileEvent
| where TimeGenerated > ago(7d)
| where TargetFilePath has_any (@"\Google\Chrome\User Data\", @"\Microsoft\Edge\User Data\", @"\Naver\Naver Whale\User Data\")
| where TargetFileName in~ ("Secure Preferences", "Preferences", "manifest.json", "bg.js")
| where ActingProcessName has_any ("powershell.exe", "pwsh.exe", "wscript.exe", "cscript.exe", "mshta.exe", "cmd.exe", "rundll32.exe", "regsvr32.exe")
| where ActorUsername !endswith "$"
| project TimeGenerated, DvcHostname, ActorUsername,
          ActingProcessName, ActingProcessCommandLine,
          TargetFileName, TargetFilePath, EventType
| order by TimeGenerated desc

ucs.title: [LLM] Kimsuky (APT43 / TA427) AppleSeed / BabyShark cloud-API C2 — Office/HWP-spawned PowerShell or mshta beaconing to Dropbox / Google Drive / pC
ucs.description: Hunts the characteristic Kimsuky post-exploitation chain documented by Mandiant, KISA, AhnLab and JPCERT: a phishing-borne HWP, DOCX or LNK spawns mshta.exe / PowerShell / wscript that talks straight to legitimate cloud-storage REST APIs (Dropbox, Google Drive, pCloud, Yandex.Disk) as both staging and C2 channel. AppleSeed and BabyShark hard-code Bearer tokens in the payload and pull commands from per-victim folders — making lineage (Office/HWP → script host → cloud-API egress) extremely actor-specific.
ucs.splunk: | tstats summariesonly=true count min(_time) as firstTime max(_time) as lastTime from datamodel=Endpoint.Processes where (Processes.process_name IN ("powershell.exe","pwsh.exe","mshta.exe","wscript.exe","cscript.exe") AND Processes.parent_process_name IN ("outlook.exe","winword.exe","excel.exe","powerpnt.exe","hwp.exe","hncpvi.exe","hwpviewer.exe","explorer.exe","mshta.exe")) by Processes.dest Processes.user Processes.process_name Processes.parent_process_name Processes.process _time | `drop_dm_object_name(Processes)` | join type=inner dest [ | tstats summariesonly=true count from datamodel=Network_Traffic.All_Traffic where All_Traffic.dest IN ("api.dropboxapi.com","content.dropboxapi.com","www.googleapis.com","oauth2.googleapis.com","api.pcloud.com","eapi.pcloud.com","cloud-api.yandex.net","api-content.dropbox.com") by All_Traffic.src All_Traffic.dest All_Traffic.dest_port All_Traffic.app | rename All_Traffic.src as dest All_Traffic.dest as remote_host All_Traffic.dest_port as remote_port ] | convert ctime(firstTime) ctime(lastTime) | sort - lastTime
ucs.kql:
// Kimsuky AppleSeed / BabyShark — Office/HWP -> script host -> cloud-API C2
let WindowMin = 10m;
let SuspectChildren = dynamic(["powershell.exe","pwsh.exe","mshta.exe","wscript.exe","cscript.exe"]);
let PhishParents = dynamic(["outlook.exe","winword.exe","excel.exe","powerpnt.exe","hwp.exe","hncpvi.exe","hwpviewer.exe","explorer.exe","mshta.exe"]);
let CloudC2 = dynamic(["api.dropboxapi.com","content.dropboxapi.com","api-content.dropbox.com","www.googleapis.com","oauth2.googleapis.com","api.pcloud.com","eapi.pcloud.com","cloud-api.yandex.net"]);
let Spawns = DeviceProcessEvents
    | where Timestamp > ago(7d)
    | where FileName in~ (SuspectChildren)
    | where InitiatingProcessFileName in~ (PhishParents)
    | where AccountName !endswith "$"
    | project SpawnTime = Timestamp, DeviceId, DeviceName, AccountName,
              ChildProc = FileName, ChildCmd = ProcessCommandLine,
              ParentProc = InitiatingProcessFileName,
              ParentCmd = InitiatingProcessCommandLine,
              ChildPid = ProcessId;
let Egress = DeviceNetworkEvents
    | where Timestamp > ago(7d)
    | where InitiatingProcessFileName in~ (SuspectChildren)
    | where RemoteUrl has_any (CloudC2)
    | project NetTime = Timestamp, DeviceId,
              NetProc = InitiatingProcessFileName,
              NetPid = InitiatingProcessId,
              RemoteUrl, RemoteIP, RemotePort;
Spawns
| join kind=inner Egress on DeviceId
| where NetTime between (SpawnTime .. SpawnTime + WindowMin)
| project SpawnTime, NetTime,
          DelaySec = datetime_diff('second', NetTime, SpawnTime),
          DeviceName, AccountName,
          ParentProc, ParentCmd, ChildProc, ChildCmd,
          RemoteUrl, RemoteIP, RemotePort
| order by SpawnTime desc
ucs.sentinel_kql:
// Kimsuky AppleSeed / BabyShark — Office/HWP -> script host -> cloud-API C2 (Sentinel SecurityEvent fallback)
let PhishParents = dynamic(["outlook.exe","winword.exe","excel.exe","powerpnt.exe","hwp.exe","hncpvi.exe","hwpviewer.exe","explorer.exe","mshta.exe"]);
let CloudC2 = dynamic(["api.dropboxapi.com","content.dropboxapi.com","api-content.dropbox.com","googleapis.com","oauth2.googleapis.com","api.pcloud.com","eapi.pcloud.com","cloud-api.yandex.net"]);
SecurityEvent
| where TimeGenerated > ago(7d)
| where EventID == 4688
| where NewProcessName has_any (@"\powershell.exe", @"\pwsh.exe", @"\mshta.exe", @"\wscript.exe", @"\cscript.exe")
| extend ParentLeaf = tolower(tostring(split(ParentProcessName, @"\")[-1]))
| where ParentLeaf in~ (PhishParents)
| where SubjectUserName !endswith "$"
| where CommandLine has_any (CloudC2)
      or CommandLine has_any ("Invoke-RestMethod","Invoke-WebRequest","Net.WebClient","WebRequest","Bearer ","Authorization:","-EncodedCommand")
| project TimeGenerated, Computer, SubjectUserName,
          NewProcessName, CommandLine, ParentProcessName
| order by TimeGenerated desc
